goal.vi: Mở tài khoản, rút và chuyển tiền, hỏi phí và báo khoản trừ tiền lạ.
goal.en: Open an account, take out and send money, ask about fees and report a strange charge.

lines: Good morning. How can I help you today?
Hi. I'd like to open a checking account.
Sure. I just need a photo ID.
Here you go. Are there any fees for this account?
No monthly fee if you keep 500 dollars in it.
Great. Also, my card was declined yesterday, and there's a charge on my statement that I don't recognize.
Let me check… This looks wrong. I'll cancel the card and order you a new one.
Thank you. And how do I transfer money to another account?
You can do it in the app. I'll show you.

phrases.say: I'd like to open a checking account.
phrases.not: I want to make a bank account.

mean.vi: Nói bạn muốn mở tài khoản
mean.en: Say you want a new account

why.vi: Ta "open" một tài khoản; "checking" là tài khoản dùng hằng ngày ở Mỹ.
why.en: You "open" an account; "checking" is the everyday US account.

phrases.not: I want to take out money 200.

why.vi: Đặt số tiền ngay sau "withdraw" hoặc "take out".
why.en: Put the amount right after "withdraw" or "take out".

phrases.say: My card was declined. Can you check what happened?

mean.vi: Báo thẻ bị từ chối thanh toán
mean.en: Say your card did not work

why.vi: Cửa hàng và ngân hàng dùng từ "declined".
why.en: "Declined" is the word stores and banks use.

phrases.say: There's a charge on my account that I don't recognize.
phrases.not: Somebody stole money from my account!

mean.vi: Báo một khoản trừ tiền lạ
mean.en: Report a payment you didn't make

why.vi: Nói sự việc trước; để ngân hàng kiểm tra.
why.en: Give the facts first; let the bank check it.

phrases.say: How do I transfer money to another account?
phrases.not: How I can send money other account?

why.vi: Trong câu hỏi, đặt "do" trước chủ ngữ: "How do I…?"
why.en: In questions, put "do" before the subject: "How do I…?"

phrases.say: Are there any fees for this?

mean.en: Ask if you have to pay extra

why.vi: Kết thúc câu hỏi bằng "or not" có thể nghe thiếu lịch sự.
why.en: Ending a question with "or not" can sound rude.

phrases.say: I think I lost my card. Can you cancel it?
phrases.not: My card is lost, close it.

mean.en: Ask to stop a lost card

why.vi: Dùng "cancel" cho thẻ bị mất, rồi xin thẻ mới.
why.en: Use "cancel" for a lost card, then ask for a new one.

ai.name: Olivia
ai.goal: help the learner with an account and a card problem

roleplay.you: At the bank: open an account, ask about fees, then report a charge you don't recognize.

turns.a: Good morning. How can I help you today?
turns.h: Hi. I'd like to open a checking account.
br: Sure, I can help with that.

turns.a: Here's the form. Do you have any questions?
turns.h: Yes. Are there any fees for this account?
br: No monthly fee if you keep 500 dollars in it.

turns.h: Yes. There's a charge on my card that I don't recognize.
br: Let me check that for you.

turns.a: This payment looks wrong. Should I cancel the card?
turns.h: Yes, please cancel it. Can I get a new one?

roleplay.end: Your new card will arrive in five days, and the money will be back in your account. Have a good day!
